svg.title: J11 Customer tools: totals, call, chat, change the phone number, delete with Undo (v1.2)

g.text: J11 Customer tools: totals, call, chat, change the phone number, delete with Undo (v1.2)
v1.2 add-on customer.js, through the window.Hisaab hooks of app.js.
Nothing new is stored: the customer and the entries stay under 'hisaab.v1'.
v1.2.1: on a screen 1280 px or wider the left column reads
entries, balance chart, customer tools, customer details;
the record form stands on the right.
v1.2.2 and v1.2.3: the page head also has the WhatsApp check
the reminder link with the balance is
the total outstanding on the overview follows each of these:
the new number, the delete and the Undo
